profile.headline: Self Employed Web Developer and Graphic Designer
profile.summary: During my six years at Cornerstone Research in San Francisco, I had worked as an administrative professional in three very different departments, which had allowed me to acquire well rounded administrative skills as well as the opportunity to see how the entire administrative support effort functions in a company. In addition to experience in facilities/office services and recruiting, I helped outline processes to centralize our billing across six offices at our San Francisco office, as well as designed electronic signature stamps and paperless filing and communication procedures so that bills can be reviewed and approved remotely.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
- Created electronic filing system involving document scanning and informational naming structure
- Scanned and renamed hundreds of archival documents to be included in new system
- Traveled to Massachusetts to assist with construction and remodeling of home office
- Maintained office cleanliness
- Filing and other ad hoc duties as requested

company.name: Jonathon's Yard and Garden Equipment Repair

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
- Filing, Quickbooks entry, allocation, and management of payments and expenses
 - Data entry of Loan Applicant information and management of client information in Salesforce CRM system
 - Completed and proofed California Finance Lenders License application with the DBO
 - Redesigned and developed website for Kedma Capital to incorporate lead generation and collection as well as integrate SEO and Google AdWords keywords via landing pages and blog posts
 - Managed and coordinated freelance contractors in developing a Javascript loan calculator web application and refitted and styled the end product to match site based on desired outcome from employer
 - Maintained relationships with outside vendors and facilities services agents.
 - Maintained upkeep of office and kitchen areas, including ordering office supplies and machinery as needed.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
- Processed cash receipts for bank deposits. 
 - Made payments for utilities for the office and various properties owned by the firm. 
 - Maintained relationships with vendors and customer service agents. 
 - Filing and ad hoc duties as requested.

positions.title: Billing Administrator
positions.description:
- Spearheaded firm-wide effort to centralize the billing process in the San Francisco office. 
 - Processed invoices, including time narrative edits and expense breakdowns and backup for up to 50 clients on a monthly basis. 
 - Processed cash receipts for the daily bank deposit. 
 - Created a paperless backup and filing process for cash receipts and check copies. 
 - Created electronic signatures and signing process for bill signers outside of the San Francisco office. 
 - Filing and ad hoc duties as requested.

positions.title: Recruiting Administrator
positions.description:
- Processed applications into the in-house Microsoft Access recruiting database for review. 
 - Posted job descriptions at various top tier University job boards and Economic and Financial publications. 
 - Worked with various top tier University career centers in planning for on-campus recruiting presentations. 
 - Created operating procedures process flow charts for Analyst and Associate Recruiting in Adobe Illustrator as needed. 
 - Created a master calendar of events and tasks for Associate Recruiting, including general upkeep and troubleshooting technical issues in Microsoft Outlook. 
 - Set up and organized a web-based Portal page housing important files and information, including general upkeep and troubleshooting technical issues with IT. 
 - Coordinated New Employee Orientation and Training for West Coast consulting staff and firm-wide corporate new hires, including travel logistics, presenter scheduling, coordinating IT and Facilities requests, managing mentor and advisor information. 
 - Coordinated candidate scheduling, including: establishing interview dates, creating interview schedules, confirming schedules with interviewers and candidates, preparing candidate materials for interviewers. 
 - Coordinated candidate travel logistics, including contacting candidates to make travel arrangements, reserving hotel and car service between offices. 
 - Candidate tracking by creating and updating Excel spreadsheets to track candidate status, and accessing and updating the in-house Microsoft Access recruiting database, files and folders on the Local Area Network 
 - Coordinated local logistics for candidates during in-office interviews including: reserving conference rooms for interviews and presentations, setting up candidate presentations (e.g., invitations to staff, ordering lunch, preparing computer facilities, etc.), and scheduling candidate decision meetings. 
 - Worked with Associate and Analyst Recruiting Heads and Coordinators with additional assistance

positions.title: Administrative Services Assistant/Office Services Assistant
positions.description:
- Assisted with Associate and Analyst Recruiting as the Local Recruiting Admin for San Francisco, responsibilities include: candidate scheduling, candidate travel logistics, candidate tracking, local logistics for candidates during in- office interviews, and provide any additional assistance as needed or requested. 
 - Assisted with case demands, including: production/reproducing binders and document logging in Filesurf. 
 - Scheduled meetings utilizing web-based conference room scheduling software. 
 - Experience in Facilities include: invoice coding, conduct Safety training of Emergency Evacuation Procedures, receive and distribute mail and packages daily, front desk reception, order office and kitchen supplies, installation and repair of office equipment, assist with daily building maintenance and upkeep.

positions.title: Office Services Assistant/Receiving Clerk
positions.description:
- Received and distribute mail and packages daily for over 250 employees. 
 - Created and maintained upkeep of employee mailboxes, which included establishing a system of reference utilized by all employees to help expedite distribution of interoffice material. 
 - Ordered supplies for kitchen, shipping, and general office supplies. 
 - Performed installs and repair of office equipment (keyboard trays, assembling office chairs, etc.). 
 - Provided daily front desk reception coverage for breaks and lunch. 
 - Executed minor maintenance on copy machines 
 - Resolved shipping issues and assisted with recovering lost packages by establishing a working relationship with FedEx and DHL customer service representatives and sales people. 
 - Set up auditoriums and conference rooms for meetings and company-wide events. 
 - Assisted with daily building maintenance and upkeep. 
 - Fulfilled duties of the Facilities Manager when absent or unavailable.

positions.title: Front Desk Receptionist
positions.description:
- Performed high volume switchboard operation. 
 - Effectively and efficiently responded to customer service e-mails and requests. 
 - Received and sorted mail and packages daily for delivery. 
 - Performed data entry of customer and school information into the CAS system database. 
 - Filed marketing materials and reports. 
 - Performed additional office duties as needed.

volunteerExperiences.description: Urban beautification and participation in various fundraising events.
